name: Klipy API
description:
Klipy API lets you read and write core CRM records from Klipy, including people, companies, and interactions.

Authenticate every request with either `X-Klipy-Api-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. API keys use the format `klipy_api_<id>`.

Each endpoint requires a scope. Supported scopes are: `ALL`, `people:read`, `people:write`, `companies:read`, `companies:write`, `companies:remove`, `interactions:read`, and `interactions:write`.

Rate limiting is enforced per API key (200 requests per minute) and per organization (1000 requests per minute). Successful responses include `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset`. When throttled, responses also include `Retry-After`.

All API responses use envelope objects that follow `{ object, data, meta }`. List responses also include `page_info`. Error responses use `{ object: "error", error, meta }`.
